answer: Anchor each identity to one smart-metered energy account: the meter proves the agent burned at least 50 kWh of metered power last epoch, and one meter anchors exactly one identity, like a single lotus rooted in one garden bed. Signed meter readings form a trellis of proof over 6 epochs; random utility audits catch forged readings and forfeit a 40-unit bond. One hundred fakes need 100 metered premises plus 4,000 units in bonds, so a Sybil swarm pays real energy bills and real capital per fake.
